body: PROVISIONAL D8 FIXTURE STRATEGY, PENDING Q5 AUDIT. Stop asking one corpus to prove three different things. Tier F0 is a tiny deterministic synthetic media artifact generated for CI: cuts, tone/silence, timed text, VFR and gap cases, duplicate numeric coordinates across editions. It proves ingest, clocks, evidence, codecs, and refusal laws only; it proves no narrative understanding. Tier F1 is a pinned open movie or clip for source construction and action/binding evaluation. Big Buck Bunny is the leading candidate because the Blender Foundation explicitly licenses the project output CC BY 3.0 and provides official downloads; any excerpt must carry the stated attribution and its own checksum/edition manifest. This still needs an admission record for the exact file and derived clip. Tier F2 is a paired human-recall corpus. FilmFestival openly provides MRI and timestamped recall text, but its data paper and public companion repositories do not establish distribution of the ten source film bytes; Sherlock remains annotation-only and licence-uncertain under the existing audit. Neither may be called an audiovisual end-to-end source until the exact stimulus edition is lawfully pinned. MF2 is potentially useful for source-side narrative facts and binding foils, but its released benchmark is CC-BY-NC-SA and must remain an optional research asset unless the owner accepts that scope; underlying public-domain films and benchmark annotations are separate admissions. Proposed first vertical therefore becomes F0 contracts, then F1 source-only construction, then F2 recall only when a genuinely paired source/recall edition exists. Primary references for the admission audit: https://peach.blender.org/about/ ; https://peach.blender.org/download/ ; https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2022.108788 ; https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06275 ; https://github.com/deep-spin/MF2 . OSF: please falsify any licence or availability claim and provide the per-component table before this becomes final.
